title: Provision of UG rain water collection sump and civil maintenance to the Lighthouse tower, Allied buildings, compound wall at Kodikkarai lighthouse under Chennai Directorate.
summary: Construction of an underground rain water collection sump and civil maintenance of the lighthouse tower, allied buildings and compound wall at Kodikkarai Lighthouse, Nagapattinam District.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Chennai

sites.name: Kodikkarai lighthouse
sites.work: UG rain water collection sump; civil maintenance to lighthouse tower, allied buildings, compound wall

scope.item: Provision of UG rain water collection sump
Civil maintenance to the Lighthouse tower, Allied buildings, compound wall

money.notes: Estimated cost including 18% GST. Percentage rate contract. EMD by DD/FDR in favour of The Director of Lighthouses and Lightships, Chennai, valid 90 days (table says three months) from technical bid opening; EMD exempt for valid MSME/NSIC certificate holders. No tender fee.

period.completion: 06 (Six) months from the date of handing over of site
period.bid_validity: 90 days from the date of opening of technical bid

eligibility: Valid registration in appropriate category & class with CPWD, State PWD, Railways, MES, BSNL etc or other State/Central Govt/PSU/Autonomous bodies

Similar works completed in last seven years: three works each >= 40%, or two works each >= 50%, or one work >= 80% of estimated cost; value updated at 7% p.a.; experience certificate from officer not below Executive Engineer
Similar works: construction of building/compound wall/retaining wall/RCC work, and repairs and civil maintenance of building
Average annual turnover on construction works (CA certified) at least 40% of estimated cost over last 3 financial years ending 31 March 2026
Key technical personnel for supervision and execution
Tender acceptance letter, unconditional bid undertaking, bid security declaration, not-blacklisted affidavit, list of relatives in MoPSW/DGLL, Make in India self-certification
notes: NIT dated 21/08/2026; bid download/submission 24/08/26 09:00 to 10/09/26 15:00, EMD up to 10/09/26 15:00, opening 11/09/26 15:00. Document is Section I only (pages 3-6); no BOQ. Hindi text of clause 1.7 refers to roof repair of power house and inspection quarters at Kilakkarai lighthouse station, apparently copied from another tender; the English text names the Kodikkarai work.
